$comment: User-facing facts that are not views: the panel, the right-click commands, the settings, the install and first-use steps. Screenshots live in docs/images as <name>-light.png and <name>-dark.png. The view list comes from src/modules/insights/views/catalog.json. `npm run docs` writes the generated parts of README.md and builds the GitHub Pages site from both files; `npm run docs:check` fails when they disagree with the code (see scripts/docs.mjs).
tagline: See your Zotero library as networks and charts.
intro: Zotero Bibliometero adds an Insights panel to Zotero that turns your library into networks and charts. It shows which research groups recur in your reading, which journals and conferences hold your field, and how your library spreads over time. Click any bar, slice or author and Zotero selects exactly those items. Everything runs inside Zotero, with no account and no data leaving your computer.

hero.alt: Zotero with the Insights panel open under the item list, showing a co-authorship network coloured by research group.
hero.caption: The Insights panel under the item list, showing the research groups in a library of about 500 items.

panel.title: Opens under your item list
panel.text: The chart button in the tab bar opens Insights as a panel below the item list, so your library stays in view. Drag the divider (or focus it and use the arrow keys) to resize it; Zotero remembers the height.

panel.title: Maximize to a full tab
panel.text: Maximize moves Insights into its own Zotero tab for a bigger map. Restore puts it back under the list, on the same view.

panel.title: Whole library or a curated set
panel.text: The switch in the header picks what the views show: the whole library you have selected on the left (My Library or a group), or a curated set of items you pick. The set is kept per library and does not touch your tags or collections.

panel.title: Every number leads to its items
panel.text: Click a bar, a slice or an author and Insights selects exactly those items in the item list, and says so in the status line. A bar that says 12 selects 12 items.

panel.title: Says what you are looking at
panel.text: The status line under each view explains it in one sentence: what is counted, what was left out and why, and what a click does. Network maps also show a legend.

panel.title: Figures ready for a paper
panel.text: Export PNG and Export SVG save the current view as a figure on a white background, with a title, legend and a caption naming the library and date, at 2400 by 1440 pixels for the PNG.

panel.title: Stays up to date
panel.text: Add, edit, trash or delete items, change the curated set, or select another library, and the open view refreshes on its own. Light and dark follow Zotero unless you pick one in Settings.

commands.label: Add to Insights curated set
commands.text: Adds the selected items to the curated set. When all of them are already in the set, the command reads Remove from Insights curated set instead.

commands.label: Remove from Insights curated set
commands.text: Removes the selected items from the curated set.

commands.label: Add collection to Insights curated set
commands.text: Adds the items in the collection to the curated set. Items that are only in its subcollections are not added.

items.label: Theme
items.text: auto follows Zotero; light and dark force one look. Exported figures are always light.

items.label: Source
items.text: Whole library or Curated set. Same as the switch in the panel header.

items.label: Top-N (ranked charts)
items.text: How many bars Top sources and Top authors show. The Show top box in each chart's header overrides it for that chart.

install: Download zotero-bibliometero.xpi from the latest release.
Click the gear icon, choose Install Plugin From File, and pick the downloaded file.

firstUse.text: Click the chart button at the right end of the tab bar. The Insights panel opens under your item list.
firstUse.alt: The Insights chart button at the right end of the Zotero tab bar, circled.

firstUse.text: Pick a view from the strip at the top of the panel.
Click a bar or a slice to select those items in your library. On the network maps, click an author to see their co-authors and double-click to select their items.

installNote: Installed copies update themselves when a new version is released.
